comparisons.peer_topic: Adoption of ASU 2023-07 on Segment Reporting
comparisons.peer_summary: The Company adopted FASB ASU 2023-07 in the fourth quarter of 2024 to enhance disclosures about significant segment expenses, as this standard was effective for fiscal year 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Micron disclose their adoption status of FASB ASU 2023-07, which enhances segment expense disclosures. A key difference is the timing of adoption relative to the fiscal year end: AMD adopted the standard in the fourth quarter of 2024, applying it to its fiscal year 2024 results, whereas Micron notes that the standard is effective for its 2025 annual reporting and has not yet been adopted in 2024.

sentences.text: This ASU is effective for our annual reporting for 2025 on a retrospective basis.
This standard will impact our disclosures and will not impact our financial statements.
This ASU is effective for the Company's fiscal year 2024 and interim periods in fiscal year 2025.
The Company adopted this standard in the fourth quarter of 2024.
